title: The Telangana Railways, Government Irrigation Sources and other Public Buildings Protection Act, 1321 Fasli.
full_text: The Telangana Railways, Government Irrigation Sources and other Public Buildings Protection Act, 1321 Fasli. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 13211 Act Number: 1 Enactment Date: 1321-07-07 Act Year: 1321 Short Title: The Telangana Railways, Government Irrigation Sources and other Public Buildings Protection Act, 1321 Fasli. Department: Department of Revenue Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Short title, commencement and extent. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Collector and Superintending Engineer may inspect irrigation sources. Section 4. When Collector considers necessary to have any work executed to protect any railway, Government irrigation sources or public building, he shall cause plan and estimate of proposed work to be prepared. Section 5. Collector to send plan and estimate to landholder concerned with order to execute work or show cause why he should not execute it. Section 6. Collector may cancel or modify order. Section 7. If order is upheld, Collector to call upon landholder by notice to execute work. Section 8. Persons concerned may submit objections to Collector as to nature of proposed work. Section 9. If landholder fails to execute work, Collector shall report the matter to Government who may direct execution thereof. Section 10. After execution of work, memorandum for payment of cost thereof to be served on landholder. Section 11. Procedure in case of emergency. Section 12. Collector to decide amount to be paid by landholder. Section 13. Collector may appoint punch to determine liability of landholder. Section 14. If landholder fails to pay amount, Collector may recover it as arrears of land revenue. Section 15. Compensation to landholder for loss caused by execution of work. Section 16. Collector may appoint “Punch” to settle compensation. Section 17. If landholder is dissatisfied with compensation awarded he may have arbitrator appointed. Section 18. Notice, how to be served. Section 19. Procedure when Collector is of opinion that portion of cost should be borne by the local authority or Government. Section 20. When Collector considers work in respect of any irrigation source under control of Government should be executed for protection of railway, Government Irrigation sources or public building, he shall report to Government. Section 21. Damage not to be claimed for breach of this Act. Section 22. Government may confer upon Deputy or Assistant Collector powers of Collector.
